name: hedera-agent-ops
description: On-chain agent registry where registered agents execute DeFi actions through SaucerSwap and Bonzo under spend limits enforced by contract, with every action emitting a receipt that is replayed from the Hedera mirror node as a tamper-evident audit trail.

envVars.description: JSON-RPC relay for Hedera testnet (chain ID 296). Defaults to https://testnet.hashio.io/api
JSON-RPC relay for Hedera mainnet (chain ID 295). Defaults to https://mainnet.hashio.io/api
Mirror node REST base used to replay the audit trail. Defaults to https://testnet.mirrornode.hedera.com

steps.label: Compile and run the tests — no account or network needed
Create a funded testnet account with an ECDSA key
Import the deployer key into an encrypted keystore
Deploy and wire the registry, router and both adapters

steps.text: After deploying, run foundry:associate to associate the contracts with the HTS tokens they handle. A Hedera contract cannot hold a token it is not associated with, so a swap into an unassociated token fails on delivery.
